component: Thunderbird password manager telemetry build selection

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The selected configure change adds toolkit/components/passwordmgr/metrics.yaml to MOZ_GLEAN_INTERESTING_METRICS_FILES. The accepted configuration retains it. This differs from registering comm-owned definitions in MOZ_GLEAN_EXTRA_METRICS_FILES; it does not by itself establish metric fields, retention, recording conditions or a successful migration.
title: Thunderbird selects the upstream password-manager metrics file as interesting
